pages.title: A Ghostly Favor
pages.text: Complete an available useful ritual at a table installed on its pedestal.

pages.title: A Ghostly Favor
pages.text: Prepare a ritual using its actual resource and receive a useful limited effect.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Use a table on a pedestal and Ghostly Essence from ash ghosts. Soul Cleave can supply essence from mobs under native rules. Healing and cleansing are different operations; the ritual owns its daily reset.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Pedestal is the placement condition, essence the resource and Soul Cleave an alternate source; the ritual owns actual effects and its daily limit.
